name: Archaic peoples of the Americas
summary: The hunter-gatherer peoples of the Americas in the Archaic period (about 8000–1000 BCE), after the Ice Age big game died out. They adapted to every environment, and some began to plant crops such as squash and maize.

knownFor.label: Atlatl (spear-thrower)
knownFor.note: A throwing stick that made spears fly further and faster.

knownFor.label: Watson Brake mounds
knownFor.note: Earth mounds in Louisiana, among the oldest in the Americas.

knownFor.label: Squash
knownFor.note: One of the first plants domesticated in the Americas.
